verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch4.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons, World Bank country notes)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 2,941 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; build-time assertions caught two wrong claims before publishing (Vietnam's GDP per person was also above Indonesia's in 1987, so 2025 is the first time since 1987, not ever; the Philippines' 2025 unemployment rate is level with, not below, its series low)

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
